The ~23% contamination rate may have skewed correlation and churn models trained on v1 data [UNVERIFIED]. We must re-run these analyses using the cleaned v2 dataset to ensure statistical validity.

Backfill is required for metrics derived from v1 transactions, including monthly spend distributions and feature scaling. Source: contamination_log.csv header notes. Safe to cite detection date (2025-03-12), contamination rate (23.0%), and remediation strategy. Avoid citing pre-v2 correlation coefficients until re-verified.
